ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin/Agenda ransomware pre-encryption defense tampering + shadow copy wipe chain
ucs.description: Hunts the characteristic Qilin (Agenda) pre-encryption staging sequence: disabling Defender / security tooling via PowerShell + reg/sc, deleting Volume Shadow Copies with vssadmin/wmic, clearing event logs, and dropping the Rust/Go-based encryptor. Qilin operators consistently chain these defense-impair steps seconds-to-minutes before file encryption begins, often after an initial Fortinet/Citrix VPN edge-device exploit and lateral SMB push.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmds values(Processes.process_name) as procs values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parents from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","reg.exe","wevtutil.exe") AND (Processes.process="*Set-MpPreference*DisableRealtimeMonitoring*" OR Processes.process="*Add-MpPreference*ExclusionPath*" OR Processes.process="*Uninstall-WindowsFeature*Windows-Defender*" OR Processes.process="*vssadmin*delete*shadows*" OR Processes.process="*wmic*shadowcopy*delete*" OR Processes.process="*wbadmin*delete*catalog*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*recoveryenabled*No*" OR Processes.process="*bcdedit*bootstatuspolicy*ignoreallfailures*" OR Processes.process="*wevtutil*cl*" OR Processes.process="*sc*config*WinDefend*start=*disabled*" OR Processes.process="*sc*config*Sense*start=*disabled*" OR Processes.process="*net*stop*WinDefend*" OR Processes.process="*reg*DisableAntiSpyware*" OR Processes.process="*--password*" OR Processes.process="*-no-vm-kill*" OR Processes.process="*--safe-mode*") by host Processes.user Processes.dest Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process | rename Processes.* as * | eval qilin_indicators=mvappend( if(match(process,"(?i)vssadmin.*delete.*shadows"),"shadow_wipe",null()), if(match(process,"(?i)Set-MpPreference.*Disable"),"defender_disable",null()), if(match(process,"(?i)wevtutil.*cl"),"log_clear",null()), if(match(process,"(?i)bcdedit.*(recoveryenabled|bootstatuspolicy)"),"recovery_disable",null()), if(match(process,"(?i)(--password|--safe-mode|-no-vm-kill)"),"agenda_cli_flag",null()) ) | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime dc(qilin_indicators) as distinct_phases values(qilin_indicators) as phases values(process) as commandlines values(process_name) as binaries values(parent_process_name) as parents by host user | where distinct_phases>=2 AND firstTime>=relative_time(now(),"-1h") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 1h;
let QilinChain =
  DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","vssadmin.exe","wmic.exe","wbadmin.exe","bcdedit.exe","net.exe","sc.exe","reg.exe","wevtutil.exe")
  | extend cl = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
  | extend Phase = case(
        cl matches regex @"vssadmin.*delete.*shadows", "shadow_wipe",
        cl matches regex @"wmic.*shadowcopy.*delete", "shadow_wipe",
        cl matches regex @"wbadmin.*delete.*catalog", "shadow_wipe",
        cl matches regex @"set-mppreference.*disable(realtimemonitoring|behaviormonitoring|ioavprotection|scriptscanning)", "defender_disable",
        cl matches regex @"add-mppreference.*exclusionpath", "defender_disable",
        cl matches regex @"uninstall-windowsfeature.*windows-defender", "defender_disable",
        cl matches regex @"sc.*config.*(windefend|sense|wdnissvc|wdfilter).*start=.*disabled", "defender_disable",
        cl matches regex @"net.*stop.*windefend", "defender_disable",
        cl matches regex @"reg.*disableantispyware", "defender_disable",
        cl matches regex @"bcdedit.*(recoveryenabled.*no|bootstatuspolicy.*ignoreallfailures)", "recovery_disable",
        cl matches regex @"wevtutil.*cl ", "log_clear",
        cl matches regex @"(--password|--safe-mode|-no-vm-kill|-no-snap-kill)", "agenda_cli_flag",
        "")
  | where isnotempty(Phase)
  | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, Phase;
QilinChain
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            PhaseCount = dcount(Phase),
            Phases = make_set(Phase),
            Commands = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 25),
            Binaries = make_set(FileName),
            Parents = make_set(InitiatingProcessFileName)
            by DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName
| where PhaseCount >= 2
| extend ChainDurationSec = datetime_diff('second', LastSeen, FirstSeen)
| where ChainDurationSec <= 1800
| order by LastSeen desc

ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.security OR windows.sysmon) (@EventID:4688 OR @EventID:1) (@Image:(*\vssadmin.exe OR *\VSSAdmin.exe OR *\VSSADMIN.EXE OR *\wmic.exe OR *\WMIC.exe OR *\wbadmin.exe OR *\WBAdmin.exe OR *\bcdedit.exe OR *\BCDEdit.exe OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\POWERSHELL.EXE OR *\pwsh.exe OR *\sc.exe OR *\net.exe OR *\reg.exe OR *\wevtutil.exe)) AND (@CommandLine:(*"delete shadows"* OR *"shadowcopy delete"* OR *"delete catalog"* OR *"Set-MpPreference"*Disable* OR *"Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath"* OR *"Uninstall-WindowsFeature"*Defender* OR *"DisableAntiSpyware"* OR *"recoveryenabled No"* OR *"bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures"* OR *"stop WinDefend"* OR *"config WinDefend start= disabled"* OR *"wevtutil cl"* OR *--password* OR *--safe-mode* OR *-no-vm-kill*))
ucs.rationale: Qilin (Agenda) operators are documented by Microsoft (tracked as Storm-affiliated RaaS), Trend Micro and Group-IB to consistently bundle this exact pre-encryption sequence: PowerShell-based Defender tamper (Set-MpPreference / Uninstall-WindowsFeature), vssadmin+wmic+wbadmin shadow wipe, bcdedit recovery disable, and the Rust/Go encryptor's distinctive CLI flags (--password, --safe-mode, -no-vm-kil

ucs.title: [LLM] Qilin edge-device foothold to lateral SMB/RDP push followed by rclone exfil
ucs.description: Hunts Qilin's characteristic intrusion lifecycle: VPN/edge-device account compromise (Fortinet/Citrix/SonicWall via T1133/T1190), SMB and RDP lateral movement to a staging host, and bulk exfiltration via rclone/MEGAcmd/WinSCP to cloud storage before encryption. Qilin is one of the few RaaS crews where rclone-to-Mega.io / Backblaze is a near-universal pre-encryption fingerprint.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmd values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("rclone.exe","megacmd.exe","MEGAcmdServer.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com") OR (Processes.process="*rclone*" AND Processes.process="*--config*") OR Processes.process="*mega.nz*" OR Processes.process="*--transfers*" OR Processes.process="*--multi-thread-streams*" by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process | rename Processes.* as * | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Authentication where Authentication.action="success" Authentication.app="win:remote" (Authentication.authentication_method="NTLM" OR Authentication.authentication_method="Kerberos") by Authentication.dest Authentication.src Authentication.user Authentication.app | rename Authentication.dest as host Authentication.src as src_host Authentication.user as logon_user | where firstTime>=relative_time(now(),"-24h")] | join type=inner host [| tstats summariesonly=true count sum(All_Traffic.bytes_out) as bytes_out values(All_Traffic.dest) as exfil_dest from datamodel=Network_Traffic where All_Traffic.dest_port IN (443,2222,22) AND (All_Traffic.dest="*mega.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*mega.co.nz" OR All_Traffic.dest="*backblazeb2.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*pcloud.com" OR All_Traffic.dest="*storj.io" OR All_Traffic.dest="*pixeldrain.com") by All_Traffic.src | rename All_Traffic.src as host | where bytes_out > 524288000] | table firstTime host user logon_user src_host process_name cmd exfil_dest bytes_out | convert ctime(firstTime)
ucs.kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let ExfilTools =
  DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | where FileName in~ ("rclone.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdserver.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com")
         or ProcessCommandLine has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","--multi-thread-streams","--transfers","backblazeb2.com","pcloud.com","storj.io","pixeldrain.com")
         or (FileName endswith ".exe" and ProcessCommandLine has_any ("rclone copy","rclone sync","rclone --config"))
  | project ExfilTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ExfilTool=FileName, ExfilCmd=ProcessCommandLine;
let LateralLogon =
  DeviceLogonEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where ActionType == "LogonSuccess"
  | where LogonType in (3, 10)
  | where AccountName !endswith "$"
  | where RemoteIPType == "Private" and isnotempty(RemoteIP)
  | project LogonTime=Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteIP, LogonType;
let EgressCloud =
  DeviceNetworkEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where RemoteIPType == "Public"
  | where RemoteUrl has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","userstorage.mega.co.nz","backblazeb2.com","pcloud.com","storj.io","pixeldrain.com")
         or InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("rclone.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdserver.exe")
  | summarize EgressBytes=count(), CloudDests=make_set(RemoteUrl, 10) by DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, AccountName=InitiatingProcessAccountName;
ExfilTools
| join kind=inner LateralLogon on DeviceId, AccountName
| where LogonTime between (ExfilTime - 4h .. ExfilTime)
| join kind=inner EgressCloud on DeviceId
| project FirstExfil=ExfilTime, DeviceName, AccountName, RemoteIP, LogonType, ExfilTool, ExfilCmd, CloudDests, EgressBytes
| order by FirstExfil desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let ExfilTools =
  SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where EventID == 4688
  | where not(SubjectUserName endswith "$")
  | extend ImageName = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
  | where ImageName in ("rclone.exe","megacmd.exe","megacmdserver.exe","winscp.exe","winscp.com")
         or CommandLine has_any ("mega.nz","mega.co.nz","--multi-thread-streams","--transfers","backblazeb2.com","pcloud.com","storj.io","pixeldrain.com","rclone copy","rclone sync")
  | project ExfilTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ImageName, CommandLine;
let LateralLogon =
  SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackHours)
  | where EventID == 4624
  | where LogonType in (3, 10)
  | where not(TargetUserName endswith "$")
  | where isnotempty(IpAddress) and IpAddress !in ("-","127.0.0.1","::1")
  | project LogonTime=TimeGenerated, Computer, TargetUserName, IpAddress, LogonType;
ExfilTools
| join kind=inner (LateralLogon) on Computer, $left.SubjectUserName == $right.TargetUserName
| where LogonTime between (ExfilTime - 4h .. ExfilTime)
| project FirstExfil=ExfilTime, Computer, User=SubjectUserName, SourceIP=IpAddress, LogonType, ExfilTool=ImageName, ExfilCmd=CommandLine
| order by FirstExfil desc

ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ImageFileName=/(rclone|megacmd|megacmdserver|winscp)\.(exe|com)$/i OR regex("(?i)(mega\\.nz|mega\\.co\\.nz|backblazeb2\\.com|pcloud\\.com|storj\\.io|pixeldrain\\.com|rclone\\s+(copy|sync)|--multi-thread-streams|--transfers\\s+\\d{2,})", field=CommandLine)
| join({#event_simpleName=UserLogon LogonType=/^(3|10)$/ | groupBy([aid, UserName], function=count())}, field=[aid, UserName])
| join({#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/(mega\.nz|mega\.co\.nz|backblazeb2\.com|pcloud\.com|storj\.io|pixeldrain\.com)$/i | groupBy([aid], function=count(as=cloud_dns_hits))}, field=aid)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ImageFileName], function=[collect([CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName]), min(@timestamp, as=firstExfil)])
ucs.rationale: Qilin's exfiltration tradecraft is unusually deterministic across IRs (CISA #StopRansomware advisory AA25-203A, Group-IB and Sophos reporting): the affiliate playbook standardises on rclone (occasionally MEGAcmd / WinSCP) pushing to Mega.io and Backblaze before deploying the encryptor, almost always after a VPN-edge initial access (Fortinet CVE-2024-21762 / SonicWall) and SMB/RDP pivot to a domain
